name: Process Fix
scope: Bulk Case failure grouping by declared reason and status with unknown retention and count-only summaries.

requirements.acceptance: Unlinked events are counted instead of silently omitted.
requirements.coverage: User-mode Case query links exact requested Ids and retains UNLINKED result slots.
requirements.blocker: Agent/integration events and source clock normalization absent.

requirements.acceptance: Categories have evidence requirements and an unknown category.
requirements.coverage: Case Reason/Status grouping retains UNKNOWN reason.
requirements.blocker: Expert-approved broader failure taxonomy not implemented.

requirements.acceptance: The tool does not describe association as established causation.
requirements.coverage: Unique Case counts per reason/status group and association-only interpretation.
requirements.blocker: Causal repair ranking and dependency evidence not implemented.

requirements.acceptance: External submission is optional; evidence remains usable without sending customer data.
requirements.coverage: Returns minimal group/count association summaries to Flow without external submission.
requirements.blocker: Executable synthetic reproduction and redaction/export pipeline absent.

requirements.acceptance: Recurrence measurements disclose confounders and unmatched cohorts.
requirements.coverage: Duplicate Case requests do not inflate source sample counts.
requirements.blocker: Post-fix deployment linkage, exposure cohorts and recurrence analysis absent.

blockers: Scoped metadata compilation and unit tests passed; broader integration, denied-user scenarios, actual domain policies and independent evaluation remain incomplete.
Original acceptance requirements remain partial; owner validation, comparative benchmarks and independent evidence pending.
commands: sf project deploy start --dry-run --target-org eb1a-dev --manifest manifest/package.xml --test-level RunSpecifiedTests --tests CaseFailureGroupingActionTest

native_validation.scope: one Developer org; scoped unit tests and supplied metadata only
